sentences.text: Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

This petition has been filed under Section 482 Cr.PC seeking quashing of FIR No.0263/2016 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC read with Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 registered at PS New Usmanpur, North East Delhi on the ground that parties have entered into a settlement before the Family Court, North East, Karkardooma, Delhi.
Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
He submits that the State has no objection in case the FIR in question is quashed since the present FIR is an outcome of a matrimonial dispute and the parties have sorted out all their differences.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 21:20:20 4.
Since the respondent no.2 is not present, let court notice be issued to the respondent no.2 through Investigating Officer, returnable on 25.08.2023.
This is a digitally signed order.
